jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: The Shortcut
jokes.joke: I sat beside a know-it-all on a bus who kept criticizing the driver’s route. Finally, the driver said, “Fine—you navigate.” Ten minutes later, we were wedged under a low bridge. As we crawled out the emergency exit, he whispered to me, “Still saved us two red lights.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Bus Oracle
jokes.joke: I got unsolicited life advice from a guy on the bus once. Full beard, fingerless gloves, smelled like a candle store that caught fire. He goes, 'You should never microwave fish at work.' I said sir, I don't even have a job. He said, 'That's your first mistake.' Twenty minutes, no stop requested, just wisdom. I've never trusted a moving vehicle's opinion on my career since.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Public Transit Life Coach
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: I was crying on the cross-town bus last week after getting dumped, and the guy next to me leaned in and gave me thirty uninterrupted minutes of profound relationship wisdom. He was talking about boundaries, emotional maturity, forgiving yourself. I really took it to heart. Right up until he tapped the driver's shoulder and asked, 'Can you let me off in the lake?'

jokes.title: Shortcut to Nowhere
seedTermsUsed: Taking advice from the wrong person
jokes.joke: I got lost downtown last week and made the classic mistake of taking advice from the wrong person—this absolute know-it-all tourist. He swore he knew a brilliant shortcut. Two hours later we were still walking in circles, but at least he could explain in perfect detail exactly why it was all my fault.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Plot Twist
jokes.joke: I was riding the bus when a guy told me he was a writer and asked if I wanted “a more compelling route.” Next thing I know, he’s narrating my commute like it’s a thriller. We blow past my stop and he whispers, “The real destination… is self-discovery.” I said, “Great, but can self-discovery drop me at work on time?”
